87:17.text: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

87:18.text: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

87:19.text: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

88:17.text: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

88:18.text: And at the sky - how it is raised?

88:19.text: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

88:20.text: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

88:22.text: You are not over them a controller.

88:23.text: However, he who turns away and disbelieves

88:24.text: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

88:25.text: Indeed, to Us is their return.

88:26.text: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
